acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of installing a sheer descent waterfall in the Los Angeles area varies significantly based on factors like the size and material of the sheer descent, the complexity of plumbing and electrical work, the type of pump required, and whether it's part of a new construction or an existing landscape renovation.
